title: In This World Your Wrist Shows How Many Words You Have Left
description: Grandpa Isao has thirty words left in his whole life, so he stopped talking to his grandson. Who would you save your last words for? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Grandpa Isao: 72-year-old Japanese grandfather, thin with a slight stoop, short white hair, bushy white eyebrows, faded indigo cotton work jacket over a gray undershirt, loose dark brown trousers, wooden sandals, a small soft glowing white number on the inside of his left wrist, no hat, no glasses
characters.Taichi: 10-year-old Japanese boy, short spiky black hair, tanned skin, plain green T-shirt, khaki shorts, white sneakers, a small soft glowing white number on the inside of his left wrist, no hat
characters.Mom: 38-year-old Japanese mother named Yoko, shoulder-length black hair tied in a low ponytail, beige apron over a light blue blouse, gray skirt, no hat, no glasses

scenes.say: In this world, a glowing number on your wrist shows how many words you have left. Grandpa Isao's says thirty, so he hasn't spoken a word since spring.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In the small backyard garden of a 1990s Japanese countryside house, morning light, Grandpa Isao sits alone on the wooden veranda edge, silent. [4-7s] On the same wooden veranda, close-up of Grandpa Isao's old hand turning over to reveal a small softly glowing white number on the inside of his wrist. [7-10s] On the same wooden veranda, Taichi stands in the doorway behind him, opening his mouth to speak, then closing it.

scenes.say: Taichi thinks Grandpa is angry with him. Before spring, Grandpa talked all day, told terrible jokes, and whistled the same silly little tune every morning while feeding the koi.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Beside a small stone koi pond in the same backyard garden, flashback in warm light, Grandpa Isao laughs with his mouth wide open while little Taichi giggles. [4-7s] At the same small koi pond, Grandpa Isao scatters fish food, lips pursed in a whistle, orange koi rising to the surface. [7-10s] At the same small koi pond, close-up of Taichi copying the whistle badly, cheeks puffed, Grandpa Isao grinning.

scenes.say: So Taichi does the math. Thirty words, maybe ten more years, three words a year. He decides Grandpa should never waste a single one on a silly kid like him.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In Taichi's small tatami bedroom at night, Taichi sits cross-legged on his futon counting on his fingers, frowning. [4-7s] In the narrow wooden hallway of the same house the next day, Taichi walks past Grandpa Isao with his eyes on the floor. [7-10s] In the same narrow hallway, close-up of Grandpa Isao watching Taichi go, his raised hand slowly lowering.

scenes.say: But now it's Grandpa who looks lonely. The night before Taichi's first big swim race, Taichi lies awake, scared stiff, and hears something soft through the paper wall.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In the small kitchen of the same house, Mom glances with worry from Grandpa Isao eating alone to Taichi's empty chair. [4-7s] In Taichi's small tatami bedroom at night, Taichi lies wide awake on his futon, clutching his blanket. [7-10s] In the same dark bedroom, close-up of Taichi turning his head toward the glowing paper sliding wall, eyes widening.

scenes.say: It's the koi tune, whistled very quietly. Taichi whistles it back. Grandpa whistles a question. Whistling costs zero words, so for the first time since spring, they talk until midnight.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In the dark tatami room next door, Grandpa Isao kneels close to the paper sliding wall, lips pursed, whistling softly. [4-7s] On the other side of the same paper wall, Taichi sits up and whistles back, a tearful grin spreading across his face. [7-10s] Wide shot of the two moonlit rooms, both shadows leaning against the same paper wall from either side, heads tilted together.

scenes.say: The next day Taichi wins by one hand. Grandpa spends three words: I'm proud, Taichi. His wrist says twenty-seven now, and he has never talked more in his life.
scenes.video: [0-4s] At a small 1990s outdoor school swimming pool, close-up of Taichi's hand slapping the pool wall a moment ahead of another swimmer's hand. [4-7s] Beside the same pool, Grandpa Isao stands alone by the wire fence and slowly says three words, smiling, as Taichi looks up from the water stunned. [7-10s] On the walk home along a quiet countryside road at sunset, Grandpa Isao and Taichi walk side by side, both whistling, close-up of the soft glowing number on Grandpa's wrist.
